letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. As the calendar flips to another wonderful day, my heart still skips the same way it did on 23 Feb 2025. Your smile is my compass, your love my home, no matter where we are. I adore you more with each passing moment—thank you for being my endless adventure.
poem:
Across two cities, our love takes flight,  
You’re my sunrise, my starry night.  
In every laugh, in every sigh,  
Together, love, we touch the sky.
